subject: Renewal discussion — tail-latency spike and pilot for premium SLA
messages:
From: Sonia Patel <sonia.p@bankingco.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@bankingco.com
Date: 2026-09-20T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: brief service degradation during peak window — next steps for renewal

Hi Jonas,

We saw a series of tail-latency spikes across our transactional endpoints yesterday evening (approx. 18:10–18:42 PT) that resulted in ~2.5% failed checkout attempts during our peak. Our SREs traced the errors to timeouts in your hosted inference endpoint and linked it to longer queueing at >99th percentile. This is worrying given we’re mid-renewal conversations.

We need two things before we can move forward:
- A proposed remediation plan we can sign to prevent recurrence (including concrete SLOs).
- An interim commercial remedy — either credits for the impacted hour or an upgrade path to a Premium SLA that comes with capacity reservations.

Please loop in your account lead and legal. Procurement copied here will need any addendum to be DocuSign-able.

Thanks,
Sonia
Sonia Patel
Head of Platform Reliability, BankingCo
phone: +1-415-555-0133

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Sonia Patel <sonia.p@bankingco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-20T18:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: brief service degradation during peak window — next steps for renewal

Hi Sonia — really sorry about the disruption and thanks for the clear summary. We take incidents like this seriously, particularly during renewal windows. Quick notes and proposed next steps: 

Immediate (operational)
- We can enable a short-term traffic steering rule to route BankingCo production traffic to an isolated dedicated pool during your next peak window (same region). That reduces queue contention.
- Rishi’s team will push a KV-prefix cache for stable prompt prefixes we observed to reduce per-request cost and tail pressure.

Near-term (commercial/contractual)
- We’re prepared to offer a one-time service credit for the impacted window (we propose a 20% credit for the September billing cycle).
- For renewal: we can offer a Premium SLA addendum (dedicated capacity reservation + 99.95% regional uptime + enhanced on-call support). We’d like to propose a 3-month pilot of that Premium tier ahead of committing to full-year pricing. Pilot includes a capped discount and a contingency remedy clause.

Attached: a short incident postmortem and a draft SLA addendum (proposed_sla_addendum_jonas_v1.docx).

Next steps I propose:
1) If BankingCo agrees to a 3-month pilot, Marissa will prepare commercial terms and procurement-ready DocuSign.
2) Rishi will schedule a tech sync with your SREs to validate the routing and caching plan.

I’ll be available tomorrow morning for a call if that helps.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1-646-555-0128

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Sonia Patel <sonia.p@bankingco.com>, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-20T19:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: brief service degradation during peak window — next steps for renewal

Sonia / team,

Thanks for the signal. A few technical datapoints from our end:
- Root cause (summary): transient queue-length amplification on the shared inference pool when a short batch of long-context requests coincided with a surge (we saw looped retries from one internal integration).
- Mitigations we can apply in 24–48 hours: dedicated routing, short token-level rate limiting for noisy keys, and a small model shard re-assignment to reduce tail oscillation.

For the pilot we recommend:
- Dedicated pool with autoscale floor of 2x your 99th percentile token throughput for the pilot period.
- Monthly latency SLO target for the pilot: median <22ms, p95 <50ms, p99 <180ms, with a monthly credit trigger at p99 >200ms.

I’ll bring logs and a checklist to the tech sync. Attaching our lightweight postmortem PDF (incident_postmortem_20260920.pdf).

-rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

From: Sonia Patel <sonia.p@bankingco.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@bankingco.com
Date: 2026-09-21T09:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: brief service degradation during peak window — next steps for renewal

Jonas / Rishi — thank you for the swift reply and the details. Procurement is open to a pilot, but we need the SLA metric floor and the commercial terms clearly spelled out before signing. A few clarifications: 
- Can Redwood guarantee the dedicated pool will be in the same AZ and within the same region as our current endpoints?
- We need a maximum activation time for dedicated routing (e.g., within 2 hours of request).
- Addendum must include a liquidated-damages-style cap for severity incidents during the pilot window.

Procurement has asked that any commercial addendum be delivered via DocuSign and include a simple summary page. I can accept a pilot that rolls into a full-year Premium commitment provided the pilot shows consistent improvement and the contract contains reasonable escape clauses.

Sonia

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: Sonia Patel <sonia.p@bankingco.com>, procurement@bankingco.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-22T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: brief service degradation during peak window — next steps for renewal

Sounds good — quick commitments from our side: 
- Dedicated pool will be provisioned in the same region and we can guarantee AZ co-location where our capacity footprint exists (we’ll confirm exact AZs in the DocuSign addendum).
- Activation SLA: we can commit to stand-up routing in under 2 hours for pre-approved accounts; activation during an incident may be slightly longer if additional approvals are required, but we’ll include a measured activation timeline in the addendum.
- Commercial: we’ll include a liquidated-damages provision for pilot-severity incidents and the 20% one-time credit for the impacted billing cycle.

Marissa — can you please take procurement ownership and circulate the DocuSign-ready SLA addendum (use the attached draft as the starting point)? If BankingCo confirms the pilot terms, please also add the pilot pricing and the HubSpot deal updates (deal HB-89421).

Thanks all — I’ll set a tech sync for tomorrow at 11:00 PT with Rishi and the BankingCo SREs.

—Jonas
